required_facts: Oracle acts before selecting its card, forcing Sorcerer to play faceup.
Oracle sees that card, then selects and plays its own facedown.

Only after both selections may Sorcerer switch encounter cards, before revealing Oracle's originally selected card. If switched, Sorcerer's originally faceup card is now faceup in front of Oracle; Oracle's originally facedown card is now facedown in front of Sorcerer until the normal reveal. The physical exchange supplies no additional flip step.
The before/after-selection timings govern; not simultaneous merely because both are Planning.
source_references: Printed original Oracle and Sorcerer sheets
